name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool result is still needed verbatim; below it the result is truncated. A Noul of 0.5 means Jev is unsure, so keep this low.

keepCallThreshold.title: Keep call threshold
keepCallThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that the tool call itself is still needed; below it the call is removed along with its result. Keep this low: a call costs a fraction of its result, and removing it erases the record that the work happened.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

builtinFallback.title: Built-in summary fallback
builtinFallback.description: Which compactions fall back to Claude Code's built-in summary when Jev fails or frees less than the minimum: auto (only Claude Code's own automatic compaction; others leave the conversation as it is), always, or never.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

retries.title: Retries per request
retries.description: Further attempts for one Jev request after a 429, a 5xx or a failed fetch.

retryDelayMs.title: Retry delay (ms)
retryDelayMs.description: Wait before the first retry, tripled on each further one.

onBatchFailure.title: On a failed request batch
onBatchFailure.description: After its retries, a request batch that still fails either fails the whole compaction (throw) or keeps every call of that batch whole while the other batches' answers apply (keep).

archiveResults.title: Save truncated tool results
archiveResults.description: Write tool results that compaction truncates to .claude/fast-jev-compaction/ and cite the file in their note, so they can be read back.

bashOutput.title: Trim Bash output
bashOutput.description: Trim long Bash output with Jev before the model sees it; the full output is saved to .claude/fast-jev-compaction/.

bashOutputMinChars.title: Minimum Bash output characters
bashOutputMinChars.description: Bash outputs at or below this length pass through untouched.

bashOutputChunkLines.title: Bash output chunk lines
bashOutputChunkLines.description: Number of Bash output lines grouped into each Jev chunk.

bashOutputKeepThreshold.title: Bash output keep threshold
bashOutputKeepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a Bash output chunk is still needed; below it the chunk is replaced by a marker.
